description: Galería opponent, Siobhán: a young Irish step dancer in a dark green velvet dress with silver embroidery and black hard shoes, arms rigid at her sides.

reservedRamps.$comment: Gates from shaders/party_palette.frag on unpremultiplied RGB 0-1; matches if ANY gate's ALL conditions hold. Structured, never eval'd: lhs is a channel or {sub:[a,b]}, rhs a literal or {mul:[k,channel]}.

style_prompt: pixel art game sprite, full body, single character, 16-bit, crisp pixel clusters, clean dark outline, flat shading, plain light grey background
style_negative: multiple characters, sprite sheet, grid, text, logo, watermark, blur, motion blur, cropped feet, cropped hat, floor shadow, photorealistic, 3d render
character_prompt: slim upright young woman of about twenty-five, fair freckled skin, copper-red hair in a high round bun, a cool composed look, copper-red hair pulled up in a high round bun, long-sleeved dark green velvet bodice with a high round neck and silver embroidery, dark green velvet skirt of the dress, stiff and flared, reaching the knee, with a silver embroidered hem, silver knotwork embroidery on the bodice, cuffs and hem, and a small silver clover pin in the bun, black opaque tights, black leather hard shoes with thick heels and a small silver buckle, stern, precise and proud, perfectly in step with her line, until she is won over
